title: BCH Encoder
text: Create BCH code from binary vector data, 1 input, 1 output, {Primitive polynomial} sets Primitive polynomial ’X^4 + X +; {Codeword length, N}, {Message length, K}, {Shortened message length, S}, {Generator polynomial}, {Disable generator polynomial checking} sets the option to disable generator polynomial and {Puncture vector}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Message to encode binary column vector

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial ’X^10 + X^8 + X^5 + X^4 + X^2 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | binary Galois row vector

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: Primitive polynomial ’X^4 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector

params.name: Disable generator polynomial checking
params.values: Option to disable generator polynomial checking on (default) | off

params.name: Puncture vector
params.values: Puncture vector [ones(8,1); zeros(2,1)] (default) | binary column vector
